entry.intro: Draft painted tiles from the display plates and build a patterned wall. Two to five players; computer players can fill any empty seats.

leaveConfirm: A computer player takes your seat if you leave.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends. Empty seats can be filled by computer players.
lobby.plates: {plates} display plates of {perPlate} tiles each, from a bag of {tiles} tiles ({perColour} of each colour).
lobby.freeWallOn: The wall starts blank. When a line scores, its owner chooses the column for the tile in that row; no colour may repeat in a row or a column. A line can only be used while its row still has a free column for that colour.
lobby.freeWallOff: The standard wall: every row is the row above shifted one place, and each colour has one fixed place in every row.
lobby.hostOnly: Only the host can change these.

status.chooseColumn: Wall-tiling: choose the column for your {colour} tile in row {row}.
status.waitingColumns: Wall-tiling: waiting for {names} to choose a column…
status.yourTurn: Your turn: click a colour on a plate or in the centre.
status.chooseWhere: Now choose where the {count} {colour} go: a highlighted line, or the floor.
status.clickPlace: Click one of the highlighted places in row {row} of your wall.
status.pointAtLine: Point at a line to see what would happen. Green lines are allowed; the floor always is.
status.takeTiles: Take every tile of one colour from one plate, or from the centre.
status.selectedMarker: {count} {colour} from {source}, with the first-player marker (it takes a floor slot and makes you first next round).

preview.lineComplete: {put} of {count} {colour} go on line {line}, completing it.
preview.spill: {count} tile spills to the floor. | {count} tiles spill to the floor.
preview.marker: You also take the first-player marker.
preview.cost: The floor will cost you {cost} more ({total} in all).

table.floorTitle: Put them all on the floor line
table.bonusNote: The last row adds the end-of-game bonuses, so each total equals the final score.
table.winner: {names} wins with {points} points. | {names} share the win with {points} points.
table.tiesNote: Ties are broken by the most complete rows; if still tied, the win is shared.
table.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to play again, or leave (top right).

facts.lidTitle: {count} tile in the lid | {count} tiles in the lid

board.label: {name}'s board
board.putTile: Put the tile in row {row}, column {col}

workshop.markerTitle: The first player to take from the centre takes this marker (it costs a floor slot) and starts the next round.

tiling.label: Wall-tiling of round {n}
tiling.title: Wall-tiling, round {n}
tiling.dropped: ({count} full line found no place) | ({count} full lines found no place)

notes.noRoom: no room on the wall for a full line

log.takesOver: {name} takes over from a player who left
log.tookMarker: {name} took {tiles} from {source} and the first-player marker: {result}
log.scoredLost: {name} scored {points}, then lost {lost} to the floor
log.roundOverRow: Round {n} is over, and a row is complete.
log.gameOver: The game is over. {names} wins. | The game is over. {names} share the win.
